_doc: #190-03 (w179, 2026-11-15, RULES-cooldown amendment 4:25 PM CST): roles of the s190e / s190f pair's calib c parts, for ledger_add.py (ROLES argument). As ledger-roles-190cd.json (w176): the ledger's vocabulary has no 'search' or 'confirm' role, so both parts are 'select' (the search decisions of s190e and the confirm decisions of s190f are judged on them); the slice's role is in the note and in the registry. Not merged into eval/pools/ledger-roles.json (lead's call).

golden-s190e-c.note: #190-03 (w179, 11-15): search part s190e of the 2x pair (search slice; accept / reject decisions). calib c part: Latin = the fresh documents left over by s190f, then retired search slices' and V2-era fit + search documents (4:40 PM amendment, least used first by V3 decisions); N documents (9) from the retired slices s173a-e, s186a-f, s190a and s190b (4:25 PM); distinct from s190f; cut at 4,096 tokens. The calib Latin pool is short; the shortfall is filled in the x part (4:25 PM). Staged, not ready.

golden-s190f-c.note: #190-03 (w179, 11-15): confirm part s190f of the pair (registry role confirm, RULES-confirm: z < -1 on this part's paired read). calib c part: the freshest Latin (all free fresh documents, s190f first, 4:40 PM amendment); N documents (7) from the same retired sources, distinct from s190e; cut at 4,096 tokens.
